name: Torrent Foulweather Grip Boot
description:
A mid-height rain boot built for city use rather than farmland. The upper is seamless molded thermoplastic with a matte finish, and the outsole features Torrent's ActiveGrip compound — a pressure-sensitive rubber blend that stiffens micro-channels when wet to increase traction. Available in slate, olive, and deep navy.

Common during the long wet seasons when Meridian 88's drainage systems struggle to keep up with precipitation. Practical without being ugly, which is exactly why they sell.
functionality: waterproof construction, grip-enhancing sole activates under wet pressure
what_it_says: You live in a real city with real weather and you've prepared accordingly.
story_hooks: During a flooded street protest, Torrent Grip boots became an informal symbol of working-class solidarity — vendors sold knock-offs in solidarity colors for weeks afterward.
A character slips in a place they shouldn't — the ActiveGrip failed on a specific surface, which tells an investigator something about what that surface was coated with.
